title: Star-Gazing Sake
text: Before I knew it, night had fallen. This happened right after I’d been scolded by my father for trying to peek in the hot springs again, as usual. Sakura-chan came into the men’s bath with her Finacée on her back.
“Whoa! Sakura-chan!”
My father hurriedly submerged himself in the water and turned his back. You see, once Sakura-chan takes her Finacée off her back, she turns into an angel.
“Naofumi, I came to bathe with you again today!”
“O-okay, I get it… but really, Melty-chan, you didn’t have to come along.”
“No… I…”
For some reason, her Finacée’s cheeks turned red as she approached Father.
“I wanted to bathe with Naofumi-sama too, so I asked Sakura-chan.”
“Huh?”
“I mean, even though Mother arranged it, I am his Finacée. So it’s only natural that we bathe together…”
“B-but. Other guests might be coming here too… M-Motoyasu-kun, Kou, and the other boys’ Filolials will be here as well.”
“That’s right! This is a men’s paradise—only Filolial-sama are allowed here.”
“No, that logic doesn’t hold up.”
“I don’t care! I just want to get closer to Naofumi-sama.”
My fiancée glared at me and yelled, then touched my father’s back. My father flinched and moved to the edge of the hot spring as if to escape.
“Please don’t hold back.”
“W-well, I can’t exactly do that. You’re a girl, after all.”

My fiancée reached out toward my fleeing father, then reluctantly withdrew her hand. What’s that all about? That “lovestruck maiden” pose. To have her sights set on my father even while she has a finacée named Filo-tan… Ha! Could it be that she’s planning to take on both Filo-tan and my father at the same time? I, Motoyasu, will not tolerate this “father-daughter duo”!
“Is it… because I’m young?”
“Huh?”
Even as I’m entertaining such thoughts, time continues to pass. Looking over, I see my finacée speaking to my father in a trembling voice.

“Earlier today, you were sitting next to that mercenary from Siltvelt without a second thought, weren’t you? Is it true that you, Naofumi-sama, the Shield Hero, are too concerned about our age difference to be friendly with me?”
“Ah, you mean Lars-chan. In her case… it’s just a hunch, I guess. It’s just fun to hang out with her—I’m not doing it with any lewd intentions.”
“No… you’re worried about that mercenary.”
My fiancée is saying something rather troublesome. Sakura-chan is tilting her head in confusion.
“Mel-chan, are you okay?”
Ignoring Sakura-chan’s concern, my fiancée confronts Father.
“Please pay more attention to me. Otherwise, I… I feel like I’m going to start hating myself more and more…”
Sniffling, my fiancée’s voice turns nasal as she covers her face with both hands and looks down.
“So you’re trying to win over your future Father like that, aren’t you! What are you planning to do, Filo-tan?”
My fiancée completely ignores my remark and just keeps crying. Is she ignoring me? Is that what’s going on?
“Mel-chan. It’s okay—Naofumi is always so considerate of Sakura that he never pays any attention to me at times like this, you know?”
“Huh?”
Sakura-chan is encouraging my fiancée, as if to say, “Don’t worry.” She’s truly the kindest person. But trying to win over both my Father and Filo-tan at the same time is pretty disloyal, you know.
“Come to think of it, when Sakura-chan—who’s about the same height—comes here…”
My finacée looked back and forth between Sakura-chan and my Father.

“Listen. I kind of know Sakura. She says that if you’re actually aware of someone in a situation like this, your reaction would be different—and if they treat you like it’s no big deal, that means there’s absolutely no chance.”
“I-is that really true?”
“Well then, I’ll bring the person Naofumi calls ‘Panda’ over here.”
With a “Boofun,” Sakura-chan transformed into her Filolial form and leaped over the hedge.
“W-what!? What are you trying to do to me? S-stop, don’t come any closer! Gyaaaaaaaah!”
Such a scream could be heard from beyond the hedge. Immediately afterward, with a *thud*, the panda beastman was knocked flying over the women’s bath hedge and landed in the tub.
“Ow, ow, ow… What on earth are you trying to do?!”
“Whoa! Lars-chan!”
“Gah!? This is the men’s bath!?”

The panda beastman is still in his panda form, with a towel wrapped around his body. A towel in the bath… that’s just bad manners. To begin with, when hairy races bathe, their hair falls out and causes trouble for everyone around them. But for the same reason, when Filolial-sama bathes, her feathers fall out, and her manners… Well, I stopped thinking about it halfway through.
“I’ve been thinking this ever since you put on your swimsuit—don’t you hate it when your fur gets wet? I think you look better in your Demi-Human form.”
“Don’t criticize me here!? That’s why I told you not to drag me into this!”
The panda beastman is shifting his gaze around, looking embarrassed. Are you after my Father too? I won’t lose!
“What are you doing all of a sudden!”
“See? Naofumi isn’t even paying any attention to the Panda guy, is he?”
“W-well, yeah. They’re talking so naturally.”
“So—it’s fine.”
“I don’t know what’s fine about it, but don’t drag me into this!”
“Oh, drinking under the stars is so typical of Lars-chan.”
“I was! I was enjoying myself peacefully when one of your Filolials came and kicked me right out of there!”
The panda beastman is holding a bottle of liquor. I wonder if the contents were still okay?
“I see… yeah. Lars-chan is just like that, after all.”
“What were you expecting?!”
Clenching her fists, the Panda Beastman is angry at her Father.
“W-well, judging from the context, there’s no way I’d have that kind of relationship with someone like you…”
The Panda Beastman collapsed, slumping against her Father.
“Whoa! This is bad. Lars-chan’s overheated! She was drinking alcohol while soaking in the hot spring, and now the blood’s rushed to her head! We have to tend to her right away!”
The panda beastman’s subordinates are panicking. Why are they explaining things in such a matter-of-fact tone? Father entrusted the overheated Lars-chan to Sakura-chan.
“Hurry and take him to the women’s changing room and get him dressed! He’s overheated, so we have to cool him down! Melty-chan, I’m counting on you too. You’re good with water magic, right?”
“Y-yes! Got it!”
My Finacée, showing not a trace of the tears she’d been shedding just moments ago, climbed onto Sakura-chan’s back and, casting water magic on the Panda Beastman, leaped over the hedge.
“I’ve got to hurry over there too!”
My father, having stepped out of the bath, is running toward the changing rooms.
“Naofumi’s out!”

Just as I was about to give chase, Rival scrambled up the hedge with a rustle and headed toward the hot spring. What on earth is he doing? Fluttering about, he’s hovering above the men’s hot spring, flying right over the spot where my father had been sitting just a moment ago. With his head facing the bath, what on earth is he doing? Well, I don’t have time to worry about that.
“Mmm… mmm… phew! This is the best!”

I heard him say something like that—did they set up hot spring eggs in the men’s bath or something? No, he must have been sneaking a drink from the bottle of sake or something the Panda Beastman brought. I saw the Panda Beastman drop it.
Eating something that’s fallen on the ground—how utterly vulgar. In contrast, Filolial-sama and his entourage are so refined. With thoughts like these, I followed my Father.

Apparently, the panda beastman recovered from his heatstroke right away. It was just because the alcohol hit him a little too fast. However, the panda beastman himself can hold his liquor quite well, and the women’s bath patrons said he’d been drinking quite a lot.

Come to think of it, was it from a small sake cup? No, he was drinking straight from the bottle. I’d say he was really getting quite drunk, wasn’t he? In fact, the panda beastman’s subordinate—who had completely faded into the background—had it much worse. Apparently, when the panda beastman showed up in the men’s bath and, to make matters worse, his subordinate witnessed him getting heatstroke, he got swept up in the moment and downed in the hot spring himself. What a truly foolish incident.

However, behind the scenes of that commotion, a troublesome situation was unfolding. That evening… there were some people who jumped onto the last ship bound for Melromarc just before it set sail. We didn’t find out about this until after the ship had already headed out to sea.
That’s right… Ren, Itsuki, and their party—having finished leveling up sufficiently—had boarded the ship and set off, fleeing the country without permission.
